# emoji-picker-element 1.29.1

The emoji picker of the sound settings. Unmodified `index.js`, `picker.js` and `database.js` from the npm package [emoji-picker-element](https://github.com/nolanlawson/emoji-picker-element) 1.29.1 (Apache-2.0, `LICENSE`).

`index.html` points it at the local data (`data-source`, see `../emoji-picker-element-data/`), so it never contacts a CDN. To update: download the package's tarball from npm, check it against the registry's `integrity` value, and replace the three files.
